statement: On any sufficiently tight i fringe, through its buffered side, both actual passages have an expansion to an arbitrary fixed charge cutoff, with remainder CK|Q|CK |P|K+1 + CKe−cK |Q| . (6.56) 82 Each coefficient is a finite expression in explicit power and fixed-degree logarithmic prefactors, bounded normalized inner kernels at q, and outer formal Gevrey series in a variable of size Q−1. Their analytic operations have bounded independent arguments with fixed margins. Outer coefficients may be evaluated at bounded inner kernels such as H0. Every fixed derivative has the same description with its own constants and polynomial losses.
